gse244832.allowed_use: Donor-compatible external-development profile evaluation only; no fit or calibration on its score.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time sealed sequence inference after selection lock; no labels or eQTL/ieQTL outcomes enter the model.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-fold local model training and donor-held retrospective profile evaluation.

local_model_roster.donor_pooling: Use the identical donor-state pseudobulk profiles and outer-training donor pools frozen for the ChromBPNet comparison.
local_model_roster.genomic_split: Cross donor folds with chromosome/merged-LD blocks and a 2,114-bp boundary buffer.

rules.comparison: BPNet and ChromBPNet share sequence windows, profiles, peaks, negatives, folds, and seeds; architecture and bias factorization are the intended differences.
rules.missingness: Missing or low-depth donor-state profiles are explicit missing observations, never zero profiles.
